criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Extracted information accurately matches the original product data.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: All available relevant product fields are extracted.

criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.description: Extracted information is relevant to the requested product fields.

criteria.name: Hallucination Control
criteria.description: The model does not invent or assume product information that is absent from the source.

criteria.name: Format Compliance
criteria.description: The output follows the required JSON structure and data types.
